verdict.rationale: Anrok's API documentation covers most core operations (customers, certificates, transactions, tax IDs, address resolution, filings, product mappings) and it markets itself as 'headless tax' with 'one engine' powering both UI and API/agent workflows, suggesting strong parity. However, dashboard-style features (world exposure map, registration threshold tracker, AI Atlas natural-language assistant) are only described as UI experiences with no documented API equivalent, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for full API surface verification. Missing for 10: explicit statement/documentation of full UI-API parity, API access to dashboard/exposure-map and AI Atlas features, and a verifiable machine-readable API spec.
